accordion.reason: One native details/summary item; shared name supports exclusive groups. No disabled item, roving focus, generated indicator, upstream panel lifecycle.

alert.reason: Native role=alert with title, decorative icon and description slots. Application owns announcements, actions and dismissal.

alert-dialog.reason: Native modal alertdialog, title/description IDs, command buttons plus local showModal/close helper. Application supplies a description and least-destructive autofocus action; no policy engine.

aspect-ratio.reason: Native container with square/video/photo CSS ratio recipes; styles.root.aspectRatio accepts custom ratios. Intrinsic oversized content may increase height; no numeric upstream ratio prop.

attachment.reason: Native attachment link with href/download and focus styles. Application owns upload, file validation and previews.

avatar.reason: Native image with required src/alt and default/sm/lg sizes. App owns image failure handling; fallback, badge and group APIs excluded.

badge.reason: Noninteractive span with default/secondary/destructive/outline/ghost/link presentation variants. No render-as-link or external primitive behavior.

breadcrumb.reason: Labeled nav and ordered list; caller supplies semantic li, links and aria-current=page. CSS decorative separators; no routing, dropdown or ellipsis controller.

bubble.reason: Local message surface; caller owns sender semantics, content and streaming state.

button.reason: Native button + pinned Base Nova CVA; external Base UI behaviors excluded.

button-group.reason: Labeled group of local Button children, horizontal/vertical presentation. Buttons retain their own recipes and normal tab order; no toolbar/roving focus or arbitrary nested anatomy.

calendar.reason: Native single-date browser picker alternative. No inline month grid, range or disabled-day API; browser owns calendar appearance.

card.reason: Native single surface with adapted spacing; upstream Card subcomponents excluded.

carousel.reason: Focusable native horizontal scroll-snap region, caller-owned slides. No loop, autoplay, selection model or generated arrow controls.

chart.reason: Semantic figure/caption around caller-supplied SVG, canvas or accessible data table. No plotting library, axes, series or data engine.

checkbox.reason: Native checked control adaptation; no indicator/indeterminate API.

collapsible.reason: Native details/summary with open model and toggle event. No arbitrary external trigger, disabled prop.

combobox.reason: Native input/datalist suggestion alternative, with label and options slots. No custom listbox, enforced selection, filtering callback or controlled value model.

command.reason: Native input/datalist command-search building block. Application dispatches commands; no command palette, fuzzy ranking or global shortcuts.

context-menu.reason: Flat native popover menu with local right-click/Shift+F10 invocation, arrows/Home/End and focus return. Caller supplies menuitem roles/name. Centered surface; no pointer placement, submenus or typeahead.

data-table.reason: Native Table composition surface with caller-owned semantic rows and caption. Application owns sorting, selection, pagination and data modeling.

date-picker.reason: Native browser date picker with ISO string value model, constraints and reset. No custom calendar popup, range or timezone conversion.

dialog.reason: Native modal dialog, labeled title, native Escape/focus restoration and local command fallback. No controlled open model, portal abstraction or nested trigger slots.

direction.reason: Native div dir inheritance with ltr/rtl/auto. Logical CSS follows the browser; no JavaScript DirectionProvider/useDirection context.

drawer.reason: Native edge-positioned modal dialog with local command helper. No drag/swipe gestures or snap points.

dropdown-menu.reason: Native auto popover plus local flat-menu arrows/Home/End, disabled skipping, activation dismissal, Escape focus return and trigger ARIA. Caller supplies menuitem roles/name; no submenus, typeahead or radio/checkbox selection policy.

empty.reason: Native owned header/media/title/description/action containers. Optional parts hide when empty; app supplies heading semantics, empty conditions and actions. No upstream subcomponent API.

field.reason: Local label/control/description slots, scoped id and vertical/horizontal/responsive orientation. App connects control id and aria-describedby; no error aggregation or validation engine.

input.reason: Base Nova classes on native labeled input; no full Base UI API equivalence.

input-group.reason: Single native labeled text/email/password input with value model, native constraints/reset and inline start/end addons. Label is separate from interactive addon buttons. Unique id required; application owns addon disabled state. No textarea/block addons or addon click-to-focus handler.

input-otp.reason: Native one-time-code numeric string input with native value/reset. No segmented slots or focus controller.

item.reason: Noninteractive div content row with media/title/description/actions, default/outline/muted and default/sm/xs recipes. Compose local links/buttons in slots; no polymorphic root, list role, header/footer or navigation behavior.

kbd.reason: Native kbd shortcut display. No shortcut registration, KbdGroup controller or external icon dependency.

label.reason: Native label with htmlFor association or one wrapped labelable control. No disabled state of its own; avoid nested labels.

marker.reason: Local inline transcript marker; no streaming boundary or layout measurement.

menubar.reason: Labeled horizontal roving menuitem surface. Caller provides menuitem controls; no submenu tree or popup coordination.

message.reason: Labeled article for caller-owned message contents and local Bubble/Icon/actions. No AI SDK or transport dependency.

message-scroller.reason: Labeled focusable native conversation overflow region. Application owns streaming announcements and auto-scroll; no forced follow or virtual list.

native-select.reason: Native labeled select with default/sm sizes, options slot, input/change events and browser arrow. No selection model prop; application reads events or uses selected options.

navigation-menu.reason: Labeled native navigation with caller-owned links, normal tab order and aria-current. No dropdown controller or roving menu semantics.

pagination.reason: Labeled native nav and ul; caller supplies li, page links and aria-current=page. Shared link recipes; no routing, page calculations, disabled anchors or generated previous/next controls.

popover.reason: Native auto popover with light dismissal and toggle event. Centered default surface; editable placement, no anchor collision or custom keyboard widget.

progress.reason: Labeled native progress with value/max and indeterminate when value is omitted. Native bar adaptation; no separate Track, Indicator, Label or Value components.

questionnaire.reason: Native fieldset/legend composed from local form primitives. Application owns answers, validation, branching and submission.

radio-group.reason: Native fieldset/legend with scoped shared name, bubbling change and disabled propagation. Compose local Radio children. Selection/arrow keys/reset are native; application reads change or FormData. No controlled group model or generated options.

resizable.reason: Native CSS resize surface; no split panes, keyboard resize handle or panel persistence.

scroll-area.reason: Focusable labeled region with native overflow and a default max-height. No custom scrollbar/drag API; application supplies content and can override constraints.

select.reason: Native labeled select alternative, browser keyboard and popup. No custom listbox/portal, controlled value model or upstream Select API.

separator.reason: Native horizontal thematic hr. No decorative or vertical semantics API; use layout CSS for decorative dividers.

sheet.reason: Local Drawer adaptation with native modal/focus behavior. No generated provider or mobile navigation logic.

sidebar.reason: Labeled complementary surface for caller-owned links and local primitives. Application composes Sheet for mobile; no provider, persistence or collapse engine.

skeleton.reason: Decorative aria-hidden placeholder; CSS pulse respects reduced motion. App owns shape overrides and loading-region aria-busy.

slider.reason: Native single-thumb range with numeric value model, input/change, bounds, step, disabled and reset. Native accent styling; no multi-thumb, vertical or external Track/Thumb components.

spinner.reason: Labeled native status with decorative CSS ring; reduced motion uses a static indicator. No icon package or loading lifecycle dependency.

switch.reason: Labeled native checkbox with switch role, checked model, reset, disabled and default/sm sizes. CSS draws the thumb; no indeterminate or external Thumb component.

table.reason: Native table, required caption and body rows, optional header/footer slots inside a focusable scroll container. Caller owns semantic rows/cells. No sorting, selection or virtualization.

tabs.reason: Local automatic-activation tab adapter: arrows/Home/End, native disabled skipping, roving focus and panel visibility. Caller supplies connected IDs/roles; no controlled selection model or generated tab/panel components.

textarea.reason: Native enclosing label and multiline control with value model, input/change, reset, disabled, readonly and constraints. No autosize JS or validation engine; field-sizing-content is progressive enhancement.

toast.reason: Persistent polite native status region; insert content after mount. Application owns queue, timeout, actions and dismissal; no notification manager.

toggle.reason: Native button plus local pressed controller and typed update:pressed model. Stable caller-owned label; variants inherit Button. No external primitive.

toggle-group.reason: Labeled multi-toggle group with local horizontal roving navigation. Compose local Toggle children; application owns their pressed models. No exclusive selection or vertical mode.

toolbar.reason: Labeled local horizontal roving control toolbar, Home/End and RTL. Text/select controls retain editing keys. No vertical mode or disabled-group prop.

tooltip.reason: Local noninteractive tooltip on trigger focus/hover, hover persistence and Escape dismissal. Caller supplies unique ID and text; no delay/provider or collision positioning.

typography.reason: Local native wrapper styling caller-owned semantic headings, paragraphs, lists, links, code and quotes. No generated heading hierarchy or upstream component API.

grid.reason: html-ui local building block, not an upstream shadcn contract.

icon.reason: html-ui local building block, not an upstream shadcn contract.

icon-button.reason: html-ui local building block, not an upstream shadcn contract.

fieldset.reason: Adapts shadcn FieldSet/FieldLegend from the field registry to native fieldset/legend. Disabled propagates to descendant native controls (first legend exception applies).

radio.reason: Local native labeled radio with shared name/value, mount-time defaultChecked, required/disabled, native arrow navigation and reset. Group selection uses events/FormData; no independent checked model.
